tour.overview:
Wadi Rum is a protected desert of red sand and towering sandstone and granite mountains in southern Jordan, home to Bedouin tribes for centuries and a UNESCO World Heritage Site for both its nature and its rock art. T.E. Lawrence called it 'vast, echoing and God-like', and filmmakers have used it to depict Mars.

This private overnight with a Bedouin guide gives you a full day of exploration by 4x4, a night in a camp and a desert sunrise.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: 2 days, 1 night
• Start and end: your hotel in Petra or Aqaba
• Type: private 4x4 with Bedouin guide; transfers; 1 night at a desert camp with dinner and breakfast
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability, the camp and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• Lawrence’s Spring.
• Khazali canyon.
• The red dunes.
• The rock bridges.
• A Bedouin camp.

WHY THIS WORKS
A full day and a night let you reach remote sites and see the desert at its most beautiful, at sunset and sunrise.

WHO IT SUITS
Couples, families, photographers and adventurers.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For a combined trip, choose our Petra and Wadi Rum 2-day tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
Desert nights are cold from November to March. Camps range from traditional tents to bubble tents with a view of the stars.

days.name: A full-day 4x4 safari, sunset on the dunes and a night at the camp
days.description:
What to expect: the canyons, dunes and arches of Wadi Rum.

Your driver brings you to the Wadi Rum visitor centre in the morning, where your Bedouin guide welcomes you with tea. Your 4x4 takes you to the Seven Pillars of Wisdom mountain, Lawrence's Spring, the Khazali canyon with its ancient inscriptions and drawings, the red sand dunes for a climb and a slide, and the rock bridges of Um Fruth, which you can climb, and Burdah, seen from below. Lunch is cooked by your guide on a fire in the shade of a cliff. At sunset you sit on a dune as the mountains turn red and purple. At the camp, you share a zarb dinner, lamb and vegetables slow-cooked in an underground pit, and sit by the fire under the stars.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
09:00 – Arrival and tea.
09:30 – 4x4 safari.
13:00 – Lunch in the desert.
14:30 – Rock bridges and canyons.
Sunset – On the dunes.
19:30 – Zarb dinner.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Camel rides can be added.

INCLUDED: 4x4, guide, lunch, dinner.
NOT INCLUDED: camel rides.

Overnight: desert camp in Wadi Rum.
Meals: lunch, dinner.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability, hotels and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: What kind of camp is used?
faq.answer: A comfortable camp with private bathrooms; bubble tents can be booked.

faq.question: Is it cold at night?
faq.answer: From November to March, nights can be near freezing; blankets are provided.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Children love the dunes and the campfire.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely; most sightseeing is by jeep.

faq.question: Can we ride camels?
faq.answer: Yes, for an hour or more, on request.

faq.question: Can we fly in a balloon?
What should we wear?
faq.answer: Layers, a warm jacket for the night, a hat and sun protection.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: March to May and September to November.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is customary in Jordan: guides and drivers appreciate a tip if you were happy with their service, but it is always your choice.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 72 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
